whyThisMatters:
Residential-only snow removal across Toronto, North York, Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill and Scarborough: driveway clearing, sidewalk shovelling, 24/7 emergency plowing; "unlimited visits" seasonal service. Founded Oct 2025, Canada. Not software — a local service business that runs on Stripe.

Homeowners prepay for the whole winter in September/October, so the cash lands before a single snowflake. The the last 30 days number is basically the pre-sale season.

This is not software. It is a snow crew for houses in Toronto and the cities next to it. You pay before winter, for the driveway, the sidewalk, and a call if the storm is bad. The visits for the season are described as unlimited. The money shows up in September and October. Summer is quiet. The prepay is the part I wanted on the page.

The software version of this is the booking and the route, sold to the crew. The crew itself is the business on this page.
